description.value: Discovery Launch Water Taxi runs a scheduled passenger service from Campbell River to Savary Island, Hernando Island, and Cortes Bay on Fridays at 12:30pm and Sundays at 11:30am (July 1–September 6, 2026 season). Custom charters to other Discovery Islands and mainland coastal destinations are also available on request. Dogs and bikes are welcome at no extra charge; freight (including bikes) is limited to 100 lbs per person.
